help.title: How to play
help.intro: Guess the Cosmere character of the day. Type a name, pick a character and you'll see how it compares to today's. You have unlimited guesses.
help.colName: Name: green only if it's today's character.
help.colWorld: Homeworld: the planet or place they come from.
help.colBook: First appearance: the book they first appear in. Yellow if it's another book in the same series.
help.colSpecies: Species: yellow if any match or they belong to the same group (e.g. two kinds of spren).
help.colPowers: Powers / Investiture: yellow if any match or they belong to the same system (e.g. two Allomantic powers).
help.arrows: Today's character first appeared in a later (⬆) or earlier (⬇) book.
help.daily: There's a new character every day at midnight (Madrid time), the same for everyone. If the colors are hard to tell apart, turn on high contrast in Settings.
spoilers.title: Spoiler warning
spoilers.body: The game includes characters from every published Cosmere book. The worlds, species and powers shown for each guess may reveal plot twists from books you haven't read yet.

about.title: About
about.intro: Cosmeredle is a fan-made daily game: every day you have to guess a character from Brandon Sanderson's Cosmere.
about.privacy: No accounts or tracking cookies: your progress and statistics are only stored in your browser.

settings.highContrastHint: Colorblind-friendly colors: blue (match), orange (partial) and gray (no match).
